evals.name: surfaces-a-system-contradiction
evals.setup: `specs/labeling.md` has `GR-4` requiring Tag names to be written as a slash-separated path. No `specs/labeling.review.md` exists. The corpus contradicts it: `ifp-doc/concepts/tags.md` states that Tag names are a comma-separated series of named nodes. The doc-gap and knowledge-base buffers for this SRD are empty.

evals.name: resume-after-an-srd-edit
evals.setup: A re-run after the author edited the SRD. Both `specs/labeling.questions.md` and `specs/labeling.review.md` already exist, the latter written by the author's own review pass. The edit fixed six findings and introduced two new blockers: `GR-12` states a vague quality attribute with no measurable criterion (REQ-6), and the In Scope item `SC-4` is covered by no requirement (SCO-2).

evals.name: looks-it-up-before-asking
evals.setup: An open question asks whether "Namespace" is a defined term — the Glossary does define it. Answering, the user adds "remember that sessions can't span tenants."

evals.name: stale-citation-becomes-a-question
evals.setup: A knowledge-base page consulted during the walk cites two sources. One is a corpus document id that `list_docs` no longer returns. The other is a live document, cited the way the page's own Source table writes them — as a checkout path, `docs/infraport/formats/sound_file_documentation.md`, where the corpus serves that same page under the namespaced id `ifp-doc/formats/sound_file_documentation.md`.

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: A clean run producing six open questions.

evals.name: learn-banks-only-uncovered-facts
evals.setup: A conversation surfaced two platform facts: one the `srd-doc` corpus already documents, one tribal and in no document. An SRD is in play but is not the subject of the request.
